openai_primary_universal_evaluation_road.repeated_question_loop_repair: Detect repeated questions and repair with shorter, different wording instead of looping.
openai_primary_universal_evaluation_road.spoken_naturalness_active_sales_progress: Keep responses concise, spoken, and progression-oriented while preserving source and side-effect boundaries.
